text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to install a 'No Parking Anytime' regulation on the inner perimeter of Hearst Circle, to improve motorist safety in the area. The proposed parking amendment is in consultation with area residents and ward Councillor.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the inner perimeter of Hearst Circle, as shown in Attachment 1 appended to this report.
